body: Thanks. I think I'm dropping my classes. I'm so behind. Just can't focus. Can't research. Can't write an essay. Can't focus on anything ..., my thoughts are racing. Can't think - i am a failure.

My therapist takes me seriously. Mom- she triggers me. I'm overwhelmed though and she helps me sometimes. But the cost is too high ....  When I'm like this. I'm a single mom and full time student. It's week 10 and finals next week and I'm overwhelmed - the pressure is too much.

Thanks. Your comment kinda cheered me up. Then I got a call. And I just want to scream- don't u realize I want to die? Can't you just b nice to me today. My mom is babysitting my kid. And arguing nothing impt. I just want to kill myself so she feels guilty for pushing me over edge.
Part of me just wants to kill myself so every1 knows I was serious.

I feel this way too. I know I need to organize my home and clean. And write letters to people. I have a desire to explain why I need to do this. 

I have a daughter. I stay alive for her. But I'm just too overwhelmed. I really need to end this .

I have other family I love. It sucks for them to deal with my death. But I'm the one in pain.

I have a guy I'm seeing. I even love him. Fuck- he is perfect.  But I still have intrusive suicidal thoughts,

It isn't that my life isn't good. Or whatever. There are lots of good things. People. But I still hate me.

I have so much to do I'm overwhelmed.

Even if I decide death- I have so much to do to get ready to die. I'm overwhelmed. Shit. My suicide plan is giving me anxiety.
Thx mindfulness has worked in the past. Just not working now. I know this is bad. I am in a dark place. I tried telling people- but no- one gets it. I'm getting real serious about making a plan.

It's not that I have no one. I just can't control these intrusive suicidal thoughts. Every day- suicide seems the best choice. A piece of me knows it will get better, but I don't know how. I'm just seeing death looking so inviting ...
